knowledge_gaps: Negative exclusion needs an implementable user lookup: the required loader yields no user IDs, and truncated sequences cannot identify every known training positive. Specify sampler-side exclusion, duplicate handling, and behavior when fewer than 32 eligible items exist.

The recent branch lacks a precise weighting formula and feature normalization. A gate bias of −2 gives approximately 12% weight to a randomly initialized projection, so it does not guarantee near-baseline predictions.

Chunked loss computation needs explicit global normalization and autograd handling. Repeated backward calls through shared sequence features can free the graph prematurely; retaining every graph can undermine memory savings.

The four-variant experiment lacks a runtime allocation, checkpoint schedule, and stopping policy within the shared 43,200 GPU-second budget. Repeated selection on 200 validation users per category also risks validation overfitting.

The novelty assessment is reasonable, but potential and difficulty scores are speculative. The scalar gate is candidate-independent and does not explicitly distinguish multiple recent interests, compatibility, or complementary purchases.

follow_up_queries.reason: Resolve negative-sampling semantics and determine whether the proposed objective is an appropriate, reproducible alternative to BCE.
follow_up_queries.query: In SASRec sequential recommendation, how do gSASRec and sampled-softmax implementations exclude user training positives, handle duplicate uniform negatives and repeated targets, and account for user-dependent sampling distributions? Compare uncorrected sampled cross-entropy, corrected logQ, and generalized BCE without assuming equivalent calibration.

follow_up_queries.reason: Specify a stable recent-history branch and assess whether a simpler recency baseline deserves priority.
follow_up_queries.query: For SASRec augmented with a causal exponentially weighted mean of the latest five item embeddings, what normalization and residual-gate initialization preserve the baseline feature scale and initial predictions? Compare zero-initialized residual projections, sigmoid convex fusion, and a simple last-item residual, including padding and causal masking.

follow_up_queries.reason: Make the evaluation plan credible under the fixed validation sample and shared compute limit.
follow_up_queries.query: How should sequential-recommendation ablations control validation-selection overfitting when comparing four variants using fixed sampled HR@10 on 200 users per dataset? Investigate paired user-level bootstrap uncertainty, checkpoint-selection multiplicity, and compute-budgeted stopping rules without changing evaluation candidates or accessing test labels.
